a3-b115: A token dose may not be enough to make the jaw release. More than once, I've dissolved Dead Sea magnesium chloride hexahydrate flakes in water and taken about one gram per minute by mouth for around twenty minutes before mine fully released. I use magnesium chloride because it absorbs far better than magnesium oxide, so you can see how it's helping, usually within a minute. Around twenty grams is fine for my gut, and I've only had diarrhea above about forty grams. Magnesium chloride is also less likely to cause diarrhea than several other kinds of magnesium, including the ones people take on purpose as laxatives.
a3-b117: Magnesium taken before the MDMA peak also makes the peak less euphoric for me, which makes me think the magnesium calms some of the MDMA's stimulation, besides meeting a need for magnesium that's rising fast. I don't mind a little less euphoria, since in my experience a relaxed jaw means a much lower risk of the MDMA toxicity symptoms.
fix-b118: My second wife had severe convulsions after an MDMA overdose. At the hospital, they figured out what caused that: her potassium was found to be critically low, and IV potassium was the only treatment they gave her. That experience is what leads me to treat serious MDMA toxicity as a broader electrolyte emergency, although magnesium is still the first and most useful supplement to give once the jaw tenses, since potassium gets depleted once magnesium runs low.
